messages:
Maya Chen: Heads-up — I'm opening a focused PR that consolidates theOptimize toolkit heuristics: batching thresholds, cache TTLs, and a set of recommended quantization profiles for common workloads. Putting it in DRAFT now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/484
Samir Patel: nice. can you add a tiny before/after perf table? ops likes numbers.
Maya Chen: yes — plan is a short table (latency + tokens/sec + cost per 1k tokens) for three workloads: short-chat (<=64 tokens), mid-session chat (<=512), long-form generation (2k+).
Leo Grant: FYI console links in the current docs point to /console/v1 which is deprecated. I'll scan and fix links after the PR lands.
Anika Rao: can we include an SDK snippet for automatic KV prefetch + batching? ops frequently asks for that exact pattern.
Maya Chen: good call. adding minimal Python + Go snippets in the PR. snippet preview: ```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.environ['RW_KEY'])
# batch + prefetch pattern
prompts = ["hey", "summarize:\n..."]
resp = client.generate_batch(model="open-llama-quant-8", inputs=prompts, batch_size=8, prefetch_kv=True)
print([r.text for r in resp])
```
Jon Kim: please also include a short blurb about when prefetch hurts (very high-cardinality prefixes).
Maya Chen: added a note — prefetch helps when you have repeated prefixes or multi-turn reuse. I'll add a warning for high-cardinality user prompts.
Rachel V: For quant profiles, can you list profiles by target latency tier? like `latency-sensitive`, `balanced`, `cost-min` with the key parameters (dtype, group size, fallback)? makes it easier for PMs.
Maya Chen: yes. current draft includes: latency-sensitive -> int8-fp16 hybrid, balanced -> 4-bit q4_0-ish, cost-min -> 4-bit q4_1 + KV caching on. I'll make the names explicit and map to example model variants.
Samir Patel: CI flagged a broken link in the README to the Optimize CLI flags. docs-bot, can you paste the failing job link?
docs-bot: CI: docs-check #312 failed — see https://ci.redwood-inference.internal/312 — error: markdown-link-check failed on docs/optimize/heuristics.md line 42 (link to /console/v1/optimize).
Leo Grant: okay I'll open a quick PR to swap to /console/v2 and add redirects.
Anika Rao: small nit — in the batching section we recommend `batch_size: 64` for short-chat by default. Can we add the heuristic: if median tokens per request < 32 then batch_size = min(8 * concurrency, 64) ? makes it more actionable.
Maya Chen: love that. will add the formula and a worked example.
Jon Kim: also include a snippet showing how to set per-route caching in the YAML example for Dedicated customers. e.g. ```yaml
routes:
  - name: helpbot
    model: open-llama-quant-8
    cache:
      prefix_ttl: 30s
      max_kv_entries: 1024
```
Maya Chen: adding. I'm also planning a tiny migration checklist for teams moving from legacy `q8` buckets -> new `q4_*` profiles: mapping table + why to try `fallback_to_fp16` if regressions.
Rachel V: can we include one short A/B test recipe? how to run small rollout comparing q8 vs q4_1 with quality eval set and SLOs? PMs want the experiment steps.
Maya Chen: yes — propose 1) snapshot eval prompts, 2) route 10% traffic to q4_1 for 48h, 3) run automated evals + human spot checks, 4) rollback if BLEU/ROUGE/LL delta > threshold. I'll add metrics and sample query for eval harness.
Samir Patel: after this lands can we extract the SDK snippets into the examples repo so they get CI linted?
Maya Chen: planned — I'll add a follow-up issue to move snippets to /examples and add a test.
Leo Grant: I scanned the drafts — one more console link inside images needs updating (SVG points at v1). I'll send a small PR later today.
Anika Rao: thanks — also can we add a short troubleshooting FAQ: "why did my batch not form" -> mention non-deterministic batching if requests come from different clients, or if request tokens > batch limit.
Maya Chen: yes. FAQ section will be compact.
Jon Kim: last ask: include a one-liner on monitoring — which Redwood Console graphs to watch (per-route token/sec, avg latency p95, cache hit ratio) and a sample alert rule.
Maya Chen: will add alert example and link to the console dashboard (v2). aiming to push the PR from DRAFT -> ready by EOD tomorrow. anyone want to review first?
Samir Patel: i'll do a pass on the perf table and the quant language.
Leo Grant: i'll handle link fixes + console path changes.
Anika Rao: I'll review SDK snippets and FAQ.
Rachel V: happy to sanity-check the A/B recipe.
Maya Chen: thanks everyone — I'll ping reviewers when ready. :thumbsup:
